text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A randomised call centre experiment found a 13 percent increase in completed calls among remote staff.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The call centre productivity gain was attributed to a quieter environment and fewer breaks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Eliminating commuting returns usable hours to workers.","cited_pids":["remote_work#1"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Self-reported focus time rises substantially for deep-work roles when working remotely.","cited_pids":["remote_work#1"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Output per engineer held steady or improved after full remote transitions in several large technology firms.","cited_pids":["remote_work#3"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A large field experiment found remote data entry workers were 18 percent less productive than office counterparts on identical tasks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#6"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Studies of software teams report slower onboarding and weaker mentoring under remote work.","cited_pids":["remote_work#4"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Communication becomes more siloed after a remote transition.","cited_pids":["remote_work#5"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Self-reported productivity gains from remote work often fail to appear in objective measures.","cited_pids":["remote_work#7"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"The effect of remote work on productivity depends on task type.","cited_pids":[]}]}
